source_refs.title: Add or install a printer in Windows | Microsoft Support
source_refs.section: Install a wired or local printer
source_refs.applicability: Windows 11; wired or local printer such as one connected by USB
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Select the Add Device button next to the desired printer.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: Connect the printer to the PC (for example, by USB) and turn it on. Open Start, then Settings, then Bluetooth & devices, then Printers & scanners. Check whether the printer is already in the installed list. If it isn't, go to 'Add a printer & scanner' and select 'Add device'. Wait for the list to populate, then select the Add Device button next to your printer.

source_refs.title: Add or install a printer in Windows | Microsoft Support
source_refs.section: Install a network or wireless printer
source_refs.applicability: Windows 11; network or wireless printer on the same network as the PC
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Make sure that the printer is turned on and connected to the same network as the Windows device.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: Turn on the printer and connect it to the same network as the PC. For wireless printers, use the same wireless network. Open Start, then Settings, then Bluetooth & devices, then Printers & scanners. Check whether the printer is already installed. If it isn't, go to 'Add a printer & scanner' and select 'Add device'. Wait for the list to populate, then select Add Device next to the printer.

source_refs.title: Add or install a printer in Windows | Microsoft Support
source_refs.section: The printer that I want isn't listed
source_refs.applicability: Windows 11; only if the printer does not appear in the list

source_refs.model_visible_text: On Windows 11: If the printer doesn't appear, select 'Add a new device manually' next to 'The printer that I want isn't listed,' then follow the instructions in the Add Printer window that opens.
